issue: The initial audit analysis assumed raw canonical program text SHA-256 was the same as runtime callable-text SHA-256 and assumed raw SHA prefix was the catalog rule hash.
diagnosis: Catalog.describe hashes whitespace-normalized canonical program text for its 12-character hash. The apply worker hashes wrapped callable text for rule_text_sha256. These represent the same selected rule but are different byte sequences.
evidence_preservation: Initial commands and stdout/stderr logs are retained without relabeling the failed analysis as passing. Initial cases/context/prepare log use rule_text_sha256 for raw canonical program bytes and rule_hash for their raw prefix; interpret those fields only using this correction. The final witness and summary use the verified identity above. The successful Racket output was reused without rerunning or editing it.
